_doc: Local water corrections applied by scripts/py/build_hydrology.py on every rebuild. Actions: remove (by id, or every feature whose interior point is inside a Polygon), reclass (id + class + width), add (geometry + class + name). Every entry needs a 'note' with its evidence.
